text: ボックスと　てもちの　ポケモンが　もっとる　どうぐを　せいりできるで

structure.jp: ボックスと　てもちの　ポケモンが

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: もっとる is a dialect form of もっている, meaning is holding. もっとる どうぐ = 'the items (they) are holding'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　もっとる　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: A plain verb placed before a noun describes that noun. ポケモンがもっとるどうぐ = 'items the Pokémon hold'.

patterns.name: 〜で (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: で at the end is a dialect way to state something firmly, like よ. できるで = 'you can do it, you know'.
